import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from fuzz import find_order, scopes_for

def cyclic(n_asn=64, window=5, extra=0, seed=3, big=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rib = []
    for i in range(n_asn):
        p = [((i+k) % n_asn) + 1 for k in range(window)]
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000 if big else rng.randint(1,1000)})
        p2 = [((i-k) % n_asn) + 1 for k in range(window)]
        rib.append({'path': p2, 'count': 1000000 if big else rng.randint(1,1000)})
    # extra records: repeated cycle paths (aggregation) and peripheral 2-paths
    for _ in range(extra):
        if rng.random() < 0.7:
            i = rng.randrange(n_asn)
            p = [((i+k) % n_asn) + 1 for k in range(window)]
        else:
            p = rng.sample(range(1, n_asn+1), 2)
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000 if big else rng.randint(1,1000)})
    doc = {'version': 1, 'ixps': [], 'rib': rib[:2000], 'priors': [],
           'declared': [], 'order': [],
           'queries': [{'id': 'q%d' % i, 'path': [1,2,3,4,5], 'threshold': [1,2]}
                       for i in range(3)]}
    core, scopes = scopes_for(doc)
    order = find_order(core, scopes)
    if order is None:
        return None, None
    doc['order'] = [list(l) for l in order]
    return doc, core

def run(doc, label):
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    t = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    dt = time.time()-t
    out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    print('%-26s bytes=%7d rc=%d time=%6.2fs links=%s %s' % (
        label, len(raw), p.returncode, dt, len(out.get('links',[])), out.get('error','')))
    if p.stderr: print('  stderr', p.stderr[:300])
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    doc, core = cyclic(64, 5, extra=1870)
    run(doc, 'cycle w5 + 1870 extra')
    doc, core = cyclic(64, 5, extra=1870, big=True)
    run(doc, 'cycle w5 + big counts')
    doc, core = cyclic(64, 5, extra=1870, big=True, seed=9)
    run(doc, 'cycle w5 + big counts 2')
